body.author: launchhn
body.title: Show HN: We rebuilt our automation platform from scratch

connector.none: no captured Hacker News connector; the Claude side serves the same response through its HTTP mock

reads.note: Hacker News v1 article get with comments: GET http://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/items/41123155 (Algolia's item tree, every comment with a children array, which Get Comments flattens four levels deep)

connector.none: no Claude connector for OpenAI embeddings

reads.note: Embeddings OpenAI v1 (text-embedding-3-small) for the Qdrant insert: one batched POST /v1/embeddings for the 0 comment documents (each under the 4000-character chunk size); base64 float32 vectors as the openai SDK asks

child execution (Trigger Insights runs this workflow again through Execute Workflow Trigger): HTTP Request with the qdrantApi credential, POST http://qdrant:6333/collections/hn_comments/points/scroll {limit 500, filter story_id, with_vector}. The vectors are 8-dimensional stand-ins (the clustering step that would read them cannot run on the bench's n8n)

child execution, after the Python clustering: POST /collections/hn_comments/points {ids, with_payload: true} per cluster with 3+ points; answered with the first four points (a side that clusters differently gets the same payloads)

writeReplies.note: HTTP Request with the qdrantApi credential: POST http://qdrant:6333/collections/hn_comments/points/delete {filter: metadata.story_id = 41123155}; the template's literal host qdrant:6333 goes through the proxy to the mock

Qdrant Vector Store v1 insert through the qdrantApi credential (the bench points its URL at the mock, matched by path): the JS client checks the server version (GET /), LangChain's ensureCollection lists collections (GET /collections; hn_comments exists, so no create), then upserts PUT /collections/hn_comments/points?wait=true with one point per comment (content + metadata item_id, item_author, story_id, story_title)

child execution: Sheets v4.4 append with useAppend, autoMapInputData, sheet by name Sheet1: sheet properties, GET values/'Sheet1' (header only), the extractor's 'Suggested Improvements' and Prep Output's 'Story Title' keys are not columns, so n8n writes the widened header (PUT values/Sheet1!1:1, write default), then POST values/Sheet1!2:2:append (valueInputOption USER_ENTERED assumed)

branches: Get Comments yields an empty list; Split Out emits nothing; no insert, no child execution
expect.n8nCannotRun: Apply K-means Clustering Algorithm is a Code node in Python (numpy, scikit-learn), and the bench image has no Python runner, so the child execution that Trigger Insights waits for fails there in every variant, before Information Extractor and Export To Sheets
expect.offline: The parent run (clear, Hacker News, insert) runs in n8n; the insights part runs in a child execution of the same workflow (Execute Workflow with $workflow.id), awaited by the bench. Insight and sentiment are model-driven; the clustering is numeric and cannot be reproduced without the Python runner. Trigger Insights is left unlisted (validate warns): it only starts the child execution, whose reads and write are listed
